description: 🔴 VERY LARGE AI TOOL LIST! 🔴  Curated list of AI Tools  - Updated 2026

summary.one_liner: A large, community-curated Markdown list of AI tools, models, and platforms (LLMs, image/video/audio generation, agents, developer APIs, and infrastructure), with notes on pricing and model lineups from major vendors.
summary.what_it_does: This is an awesome-style link and overview list rather than a software project. The README is organized into a navigation table of about 35 categories, with the first sections covering major AI platforms and model ecosystems such as OpenAI, OpenAI Codex, Google, xAI Grok, Anthropic, Claude Code, Meta Llama, Mistral, Perplexity, and several Chinese model families (Qwen, DeepSeek, Kimi, GLM, MiniMax, Baidu ERNIE, Hunyuan). Each entry lists current and legacy model names, short capability descriptions, and in many cases API prices and subscription tiers as stated by the vendors at the time of writing. Later categories cover agents, students' free resources, robotics, GPU rental, Chrome extensions, learning resources, and creative tools for image, video, sound, music, voice, and photo editing. The README says it is curated through community contributions and is in a quality-review and cleanup phase.
use_cases: compare current AI model lineups and API pricing across vendors
find an AI tool for image, video, music, or voice generation
discover coding agents and AI developer tools
look up open-weight models to self-host
find free AI resources for students and educators
browse GPU rental services and AI infrastructure tools
notable: Broad coverage across LLMs, multimodal generation, agents, and infrastructure in one list
Includes detailed per-model API pricing for many Chinese and US providers
Organized as a navigation table with jump links to category sections
Covers discontinued or replaced tools in a separate AI Graveyard section
caveats: Pricing, model names, and features change quickly; the README tells readers to verify on official sites
README states the list is in a quality review and cleanup phase, and some entries may be outdated or unreliable
Listed tools are not endorsed by the maintainers, who state they are independent
keywords: find ai tool for my task
